title: MCP Server tools + Opencode config integration + deprecation of legacy scripts
objective: Wire all ticket-engine methods into a runnable MCP server with clear tool descriptions, configure opencode to load it, and deprecate the legacy shell scripts. The end state: every ticket operation (create, update, transition, link, query) goes through the MCP server — manual hand-editing of ticket JSON is transitional only and must stop once the MCP path is live and tested.

subtickets.title: Create MCP server skeleton (mcp-server.ts) with stdio transport
subtickets.objective: Register all tool handlers and implement the stdio protocol framing per the MCP spec (JSON-RPC over stdout/stderr).

subtickets.title: Register all ticket-engine endpoints as MCP tools (create/update/transition/link/search)
subtickets.objective: Expose the full engine API — including the typed-link and subticket operations from tickets 017/018 — with natural-language descriptions the agent can reason about.

subtickets.title: Add mcpServers config to agent/opencode/opencode.json and prove it loads in v2
subtickets.objective: Wire the MCP server into the generated opencode config (via scripts/regen-configs, not by hand) and verify the tools appear in a live session.

subtickets.title: Deprecate legacy scripts (ticket-new, ticket-lifecycle, validate-tickets): warn and redirect
subtickets.objective: Scripts stay functional but emit a deprecation warning pointing at the MCP server as the recommended (eventually required) path. No new workflow docs should instruct users to create tickets manually.

subtickets.title: Enforce MCP-only ticket creation once the MCP path is tested
subtickets.objective: Add CI/validator check (or remove manual-create instructions) so that new tickets are created through the engine/MCP. This is the final gate that fulfils the 'all ticket creation MUST go through the MCP server' rule.

notes:
Requirement recorded explicitly by the user (2026-10-21): 'all ticket creation MUST go through the MCP server internally and NOT be handled manually'. Until subtask 4/5 land, manual JSON creation (like tickets 020-023) is transitional only. The MD version of this ticket is docs/tickets/ticket-012-mcp-server-opencode-integration.md. As of 2026-10-25: MCP server is implemented with 8 tools (create, list, get, update, archive, search, board, validate) — subtasks 1-2 complete. Subtask 3 (mcpServers config in opencode.json) done. Subtasks 4-5 (deprecate legacy scripts, enforce MCP-only creation) remain.

Architecture decision (2026-10-25): Little Mester MCP is a single server (@little-mester/mcp) with the ticket engine as its first module (@little-mester/ticket-engine-mcp). Server name: 'little-mester'. Tool prefix: 'mester_tickets_*'. Future modules register on the same server process — no multiple MCP servers per opencode session.
